# Aphrody docs

> Reference for fw, Aphrody and ay, generated from the code. Every page below has a plain markdown version at its address plus `index.md`. https://docs.aphrody.com/llms-full.txt holds all pages in one file.

## Get started

- [fw, Aphrody and ay: install and reference](https://docs.aphrody.com/index.md): Install fw, read every command and MCP tool, and browse the crates of fw, Aphrody and ay. Generated from the code: fw 2026.11.0.
- [Get started with fw](https://docs.aphrody.com/start/index.md): Install fw 2026.11.0, check your machine and run your first agent command in nine single-action steps.
- [Install fw on Linux, macOS and Windows](https://docs.aphrody.com/start/install/index.md): Install the fw binary with one command on Linux, macOS or Windows, then update or remove it. The file list comes from release.toml.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://docs.aphrody.com/guides/index.md): Task guides for the Aphrody stack: connect an AI agent to a project, let fw learn from a repository, and see how this documentation is generated.
- [Agents guide: AGENTS.md, MCP, skills](https://docs.aphrody.com/guides/agents/index.md): Connect an AI agent to a project: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, llms.txt, the fw MCP server and skills. Commands come from fw --help.
- [Learning guide: fw learn and the corpus](https://docs.aphrody.com/guides/learning/index.md): Harvest git history, the code graph and docs into a local store and search it with fw learn. Usage lines are read from fw --help.
- [How this site is generated](https://docs.aphrody.com/guides/docs-site/index.md): The docs are generated by fw site from fw --help, the MCP server, cargo metadata, product files and the release manifest, and checked for drift in CI.

## Products

- [Products](https://docs.aphrody.com/products/index.md): The three first layers of the Aphrody stack: fw the toolchain and agent runtime, Aphrody the OS and desktop, and ay the SDK with cloud and edge services.
- [fw: toolchain and agent runtime](https://docs.aphrody.com/products/fw/index.md): fw is a Rust toolchain and agent runtime: one binary with a coding agent, MCP, ACP and A2A servers, and local learning. Version 2026.11.21-fc4f4fa.
- [Aphrody: OS and desktop](https://docs.aphrody.com/products/aphrody/index.md): Local-first OS and desktop: GPUI desktop shell, compositor, installer and the Aphrody Studio editor, 100% compatible with the Zed ecosystem. Reference of the…
- [ay: SDK, cloud and edge](https://docs.aphrody.com/products/ay/index.md): ay is the SDK of the Aphrody stack: C ABI, corelib, OpenAPI, design tokens, cloud and edge services. Repository list and release files.

## MCP tools

- [crates_awesome MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-awesome/index.md): The ranked best crates of a crates.io category, or the index of every awesome list when no category is given. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call…
- [crates_compare MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-compare/index.md): Compare two or more crates side by side with the best crate per metric. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the crates_compare MCP tool.
- [crates_info MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-info/index.md): One crate: score with its components, downloads, dependents, releases, MSRV, licence, advisories, rank overall and per category; live=true adds the live…

- [crates_stack MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-stack/index.md): Pick crates from the ranking for a goal in words (for example `web API with Postgres and auth`) and return the choices with reasons and a Cargo project…
- [fw_ai MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-ai/index.md): Query Fw AI Brain (FTS5), Soul constitution, Router providers, or Low-Level LTO/AOT matrix. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_ai…

- [fw_bridge MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-bridge/index.md): Inspect or dispatch to Fw's absorbed first/third-party subsystems (heretic, neon/REA, craft-libs, craft-anything, ghidra). Input schema, parameters and a…
- [fw_disasm MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-disasm/index.md): Disassemble PE entry-point x86-64 instructions using craft-pe + iced-x86 Fat-LTO ABI, or identify any file via craft-sniff. Input schema, parameters and a…
- [fw_learn MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-learn/index.md): Run `fw learn` (status, harvest, distill, search, loop). Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_learn MCP tool.
- [fw_pe_inspect MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-pe-inspect/index.md): Inspect a Windows PE/COFF binary using craft-pe compiled into Fw's Fat-LTO ABI. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_pe_inspect MCP…
- [fw_status MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-status/index.md): Return Fw monorepo status, Rust C ABI (v4) health, absorbed modules and plugin status. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_status MCP…
- [fw_target_scan MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-target-scan/index.md): Scan all registered in-repo Fw modules (heretic, neon, craft-libs, craft-anything, native/*, src, tests), run AST probes, and update target/manifest.json…
- [fw_tui_terminal MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-tui-terminal/index.md): Inspect and run Fw-optimized Microsoft Intelligent Terminal (WTA) and tui-test source-only workflows. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for…
- [fw_vfs MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-vfs/index.md): Interact with Fw SQLite CAS VFS OS (mounts, ls, read, write). Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_vfs MCP tool.
- [kernel_graph MCP tool](https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/kernel-graph/index.md): Query the tree-sitter code graph of a pinned Linux kernel tree (symbols, definitions, references, includes, call edges, Kconfig and Kbuild links) with…

## API reference

- [API reference](https://docs.aphrody.com/api/index.md): HTTP endpoints of fw serve, the fw edge Worker and the ay Auto API, with the contract standards the stack follows. 3 surfaces.
- [fw serve API](https://docs.aphrody.com/api/fw-serve/index.md): 17 endpoints of the fw serve API: method, path and summary. fw control plane
- [fw edge Worker API](https://docs.aphrody.com/api/fw-edge/index.md): 27 endpoints of the fw edge Worker API: method, path and summary. Unified Cloudflare Edge OS Worker: Durable Object SQLite VFS, 3-tier execution (DO POSIX…
- [ay Auto API](https://docs.aphrody.com/api/ay/index.md): 23 endpoints of the ay Auto API: method, path and summary. Auto API
- [API standards and contract sources](https://docs.aphrody.com/api/standards/index.md): OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, Protocol Buffers, MCP and A2A versions the Aphrody stack follows, and the contracts each repository ships today.

- [xtask crate](https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/xtask/index.md): Zero-dependency pure-Rust xtask orchestrator for fw (parallel CI, MAP.tsv, purity, upstreams sync, crates.io packaging, doctor) Version 2026.11.0, targets and…
- [zed crate](https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/zed/index.md): Local-first OS and desktop: GPUI desktop shell, compositor, installer and the Aphrody Studio editor, 100% compatible with the Zed ecosystem. Version 1.31.0…
- [zed_extension_api crate](https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/zed_extension_api/index.md): APIs for creating Zed extensions in Rust Version 0.8.0, targets and dependencies.
